description: This file defines the RefreshTokenRepository class which implements the RefreshTokenRepositoryInterface for managing OAuth2 refresh tokens, including persisting, revoking, and checking revoke status. It interacts with a data source via the OAuth2Tokens class and is part of an OAuth2 server implementation within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Implementation of OAuth2 refresh token storage, revocation, and retrieval operations within the SuiteCRM OAuth2 server module.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Stores a new refresh token in the data source, updating any existing token with the same access token identifier.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Marks a refresh token as revoked in the data source, preventing further use.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a given refresh token has been revoked or has expired.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates a new instance of RefreshTokenEntity.
